content: {"episode_id":"ep-05080","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"This claim for Cardiac Event Monitoring (CPT 93271) was denied under Reason Code CO-97 as bundled into another covered procedure. The clinical indication note documents a patient with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and recurrent episodes of syncope (R55) that are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring. Per the note, a cardiac event monitoring study is indicated for extended rhythm assessment to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and determine the etiology of the collapse. We request reconsideration of the CO-97 determination on the basis of this documented indication."}
